rationale: More PPO updates (48 instead of 20) give the policy more opportunity to converge to a stable behaviour within the project's remaining 10-day window.
No hyperparameter, reward, observation, or schedule change is justified by any evidence -- this amendment changes ONLY the number of sessions/timesteps, nothing about what is learned or how.

The decision was made and recorded BEFORE any training result from session_020 onward existed (the then-running campaign, PID 26490, was mid-session_001-019 at decision time, --max-sessions 19, bounded to stop exactly at the original 5,120 budget) -- this preserves the project's own no-outcome-aware-change discipline.

Because the learning rate is constant and the training schedule (training_schedule_v2.build_training_profile_rotation) is fully deterministic given the same seed, the first 5,120 steps of a 12,288-step run are byte-for-byte identical in schedule content to the already-completed/already-running 5,120-step run -- verified directly: build_training_profile_rotation(42, 193) == build_training_profile_rotation(42, 470)[:193]. This amendment does not retroactively alter anything about sessions 000-019.
